video_caption: The video segment features an advertisement for Nick Jr. Baby’s Curious Buddies, a new line of videos and DVDs. The words “Curious” and “Buddies” are in a playful, cartoonish font, with a green outline, and a graphic of a white dog face between the two words. The text below states: "Available Fall 2004 on VHS and DVD!" A green, fuzzy puppet emerges from the right side of the screen, partially obscuring the title card as the advertisement concludes. The segment is visually bright and cheerful, aiming to capture the attention of both parents and babies with its simple shapes, bright colors, and friendly animal characters.

This video segment is a commercial advertisement for two new Peanuts classics, “A Charlie Brown Valentine” and “Lucy Must Be Traded, Charlie Brown,” coming to DVD and video. Text appears, "2 NEW PEANUTS CLASSICS," as Snoopy is shown wearing a green pilot's helmet and red scarf, sitting atop a podium with folded hands. Next, a rapid succession of images depict Snoopy and Woodstock together in a tree with a nest and the VHC tape for “A Charlie Brown Valentine” in the background. A scene with Sally standing in a classroom decorated with hearts and a blackboard reading "PARTY TODAY," anticipating a valentine, leads to an image of Linus approaching her with a large heart-shaped gift, which is immediately followed by Sally giving Linus a kiss. Next, Snoopy is featured playing baseball with Charlie Brown. Finally, Lucy is shown arguing with Charlie Brown on a baseball field before Snoopy catches a ball with his hat, which transitions to the VHS tape for “Lucy Must Be Traded, Charlie Brown,” set against the same backdrop.

Lastly, the video shows Charlie Brown and Linus in the forest decorating a Christmas tree. The scene cuts to Snoopy and Lucy standing on a stage, and Lucy screams “Ugh, I've been kissed by a dog!” The advertisement ends with a young girl making a disgusted face and Charlie Brown standing on the stage looking sad.
